data.desc: Founded in 2006 and headquartered in Changzhou, Jiangsu Province, Jin Medical was listed on the Nasdaq Stock Market in the United States in March 2023 under the ticker symbol ZJYL. With twenty years of experience in rehabilitation assistive devices, the company combines medicine, engineering, and aesthetics to continually strengthen its capabilities in in-house research and development, precision manufacturing, and quality control. Its three production bases in Changzhou and Taizhou, Jiangsu Province, and Chuzhou, Anhui Province, form an integrated industrial network linking technology development, commercialization, and large-scale manufacturing. The company holds more than 200 patents, is certified to the ISO 13485 quality management standard, and has passed Japanese Industrial Standards (JIS) factory audits.
